node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal c2 (1,1,2) ramified complete-source repair
node.closure: complete-source multiplicity repair of the ramified square-fiber coefficient cut from 6/5 to 4/3
node.statement: For a saturated source-line diagonal (1,1,2) packet whose forced square orbit is source-ramified, complete-source row divisibility caps each of the two square-root rows at order two while local saturation requires total order four. Both orders are exactly two, forcing V(T,0) to be a nonzero multiple of q=P_(J_1). The ramified coefficient cut therefore has rank four and dimensions 4/3, and the common odd-part incidence map applies. This repairs the ramified coefficient escape but does not delete a packet or row.
